today_summary: Your Wheat crop is 33 days old and in the Crown Root Initiation (CRI) stage. High humidity and wet leaf conditions create a high risk for disease development, making field scouting your most important task today.

priority_alerts.title: High Disease Risk
priority_alerts.explanation: Increase disease scouting today because high humidity (94%) and leaf wetness create favorable conditions for disease development.

todays_actions.reason: Increase disease scouting because moisture conditions are favorable.
Scout crop for pest activity before taking control action.

why_it_matters: High disease risk does not mean your crop is currently diseased; scouting helps catch early symptoms before problems spread.
Soil moisture is adequate at 30.56%, so additional watering is not currently needed.
Scouting for pests before applying treatments prevents unnecessary costs and protects crop health.
